name: Machine Learning
shortDescription: Teaching computers to learn patterns from data. Learn supervised and unsupervised learning, model evaluation, feature engineering and the core algorithms behind them.
highlights: Feature engineering and a first end-to-end model

name: Deep Learning
shortDescription: Neural networks with many layers. Learn perceptrons, backpropagation, convolutional and recurrent networks, transformers and training on GPUs.

name: Artificial Intelligence
shortDescription: The big picture of AI: search, knowledge representation, reasoning, planning, learning, agents and the ethics of intelligent systems.
highlights: What AI is, its history and its branches
Learning systems, agents and responsible AI

name: Data Science
shortDescription: Turning raw data into decisions. Learn the workflow: collecting, cleaning, exploring, visualising, modelling and communicating results.
highlights: The data science workflow and tooling

name: NumPy
shortDescription: The foundation of numerical Python. Learn n-dimensional arrays, indexing, broadcasting, vectorised maths, random numbers and linear algebra.
highlights: Linear algebra, random numbers and performance

name: Pandas
shortDescription: Data analysis with DataFrames. Learn loading, cleaning, filtering, grouping, joining, reshaping and summarising tabular data in Python.
highlights: Grouping, merging, time series and plotting

name: Matplotlib
shortDescription: Python's foundational plotting library. Learn figures, axes, line and bar charts, histograms, scatter plots, styling and saving publication-quality graphics.
highlights: Figures, axes and the pyplot interface
Line, bar, scatter, histogram and subplot charts

name: Scikit-learn
shortDescription: The go-to Python library for classical machine learning: preprocessing, pipelines, classification, regression, clustering, model selection and evaluation.

name: TensorFlow
shortDescription: Google's end-to-end machine learning platform. Learn tensors, Keras models, custom training loops, data pipelines, saving models and deployment.
highlights: Keras layers, models, training and callbacks
Data pipelines, saving models and serving

name: PyTorch
shortDescription: The research-favourite deep learning framework. Learn tensors, autograd, nn.Module, datasets and data loaders, training loops and GPU acceleration.
highlights: Datasets, training loops, saving and inference

name: OpenCV
shortDescription: The computer vision library. Learn image loading, colour spaces, filtering, edge detection, contours, feature matching and video processing in Python.
highlights: Feature detection, video and object tracking

name: LangChain
shortDescription: A framework for building applications with large language models: prompts, chains, tools, agents, memory and retrieval-augmented generation.

name: Generative AI
shortDescription: Models that create text, images, code and audio. Learn how diffusion and transformer models work, what they can and cannot do, and how to use them responsibly.
highlights: Text, image, code and audio generation

name: Large Language Models
shortDescription: How LLMs work: tokens, embeddings, transformers, pre-training, fine-tuning, context windows, evaluation and their limitations.
highlights: Using APIs, context windows and evaluation

name: Prompt Engineering
shortDescription: Getting reliable results from AI models. Learn prompt structure, few-shot examples, chain-of-thought, system prompts, structured output and evaluation.
highlights: Testing prompts and avoiding common failures

name: Hugging Face
shortDescription: The hub for open models and datasets. Learn the Transformers library, pipelines, tokenizers, datasets, fine-tuning and sharing models.
highlights: Fine-tuning with the Trainer and sharing models
